marketing_description: The Milwaukee 2761-22 Hydraulic Driver Kit is a compact and lightweight tool designed for demanding applications. It features a 1/4 in hex hydraulic driver, variable speed trigger, and metal housing for durability. The kit includes a 1/4 in hex bit holder, socket adapter, socket set, and carrying case, and is powered by an 18 V M18 battery with 5 Ah capacity.
